elements.description: The agent asks before it starts: two or three questions – choices, a short answer, "You decide" – sent back as one reply.

properties.name: questions
properties.description: The questions, in the order they're asked

properties.name: value
properties.description: The answers so far, by question id – the value

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Names the questions, as the agent says it

properties.name: intro
properties.description: What the agent will do once it knows, in a sentence under the heading

properties.name: sent
properties.description: The answers have been sent: the card shows them as the reply

properties.name: decideLabel
properties.description: The label of the answer that leaves a question to the agent

properties.name: skipLabel
properties.description: The label of the button that leaves every question to the agent

properties.name: skippable
properties.description: Offers the skip button; set it to false when the agent can't go on without answers

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: An answer changed. Cancelable. Detail: ClarifyingAnswersChange ({ value })

events.name: tc-send
events.description: Send, Enter on the last question, or Skip – every answer in one reply. Cancelable: unless prevented the card shows as sent. Detail: ClarifyingAnswersChange ({ value })

props.name: title
props.description: Names the questions, as the agent says it

props.name: value
props.description: The answers, by question id. Controlled when defined – pass back what onChange reports

props.name: onChange
props.description: An answer changed: every answer so far

props.name: sent
props.description: Whether the answers have been sent. Controlled when defined – set it after onSend

props.name: defaultSent
props.description: Whether it starts as sent when uncontrolled

props.name: onSend
props.description: Send, Enter on the last question, or Skip: every answer in one reply. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the questions open
